glyph.isekai_mahou.molten_rock.desc: Molten stone that burns the target and hurls it away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lava_pool.desc: Covers the ground with temporary magma that burns enemies stepping on it. Fades on its own.
glyph.isekai_mahou.obsidian.desc: Traps the target in an obsidian shell. On a block, creates a temporary platform (even over lava or water).
glyph.isekai_mahou.magma_armor.desc: A crust of molten rock: extra armor, fire immunity, and melee attackers catch fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.eruption.desc: The ground around spews jets of magma for a few seconds, aiming at enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.scald.desc: A jet of boiling water: damages, weakens and puts out the target's fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steam_propulsion.desc: On yourself: launches you where you look, with no fall damage. On a target: blasts it away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hot_mist.desc: A cloud of steam that blinds and slowly cooks everyone inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.geyser.desc: After a brief warning, a column of boiling water launches everything skyward. On yourself: ride the geyser.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lightning_bolt.desc: A bolt falls from the sky onto the target and stuns it for a moment. Does not set the world on fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.paralyze.desc: A shock that locks the muscles (Stunned). Lasts longer on wet targets.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arc_lightning.desc: The shock jumps on its own through up to 3 nearby enemies, losing a little strength each jump.
glyph.isekai_mahou.magnet.desc: Pulls metal items and armored creatures toward you (Invert: repels). Hurts metal-clad foes more.
glyph.isekai_mahou.overcharge.desc: Your body becomes electricity: extreme speed and electric strikes. Leaves you tired when it ends.
glyph.isekai_mahou.thunderstorm.desc: A thundercloud over the area that strikes enemies with lightning.
glyph.isekai_mahou.freeze.desc: Freezes the target (barely moves). On water, freezes the surface for a while.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_lance.desc: An ice spike that slows the target and pierces through, hitting whoever stands behind it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_bridge.desc: Creates a temporary ice bridge toward where you look or the target (crosses water and lava).
glyph.isekai_mahou.slippery_ground.desc: The ground turns into slick ice for a while: enemies slide and sometimes fall.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_armor.desc: An ice shell: armor, steadiness and freezes melee attackers. Melts in fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blizzard.desc: A snowstorm over the area: slows, chips away and freezes those who stay inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_statue.desc: Freezes the target solid in an ice shell: it can't move or attack for a few seconds.
glyph.isekai_mahou.growth.desc: Nearby plants, saplings and crops grow instantly; young animals grow up.
glyph.isekai_mahou.thorns.desc: Thorns burst from the ground around the target: damage, slowness and splash to its neighbors.
glyph.isekai_mahou.vines.desc: Vines grab the target and hold it to the ground (Rooted). Pulls down flyers.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spores.desc: A spore cloud that poisons and sometimes puts foes to sleep until hurt (Invert: always sleep).
glyph.isekai_mahou.bloom.desc: A burst of flowers heals the target and nearby allies, and covers the ground in flowers.
glyph.isekai_mahou.photosynthesis.desc: For a long while, standing in sunlight regenerates mana and a little health.
glyph.isekai_mahou.summon_ent.desc: A tree guardian rises from the ground to fight by your side: it smashes, roots foes and heals in sunlight.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dune.desc: A wave of sand rushes to the target, knocking down and dragging everyone nearby.
glyph.isekai_mahou.vitrify.desc: Intense heat: sand turns into glass and the target is trapped in a glass shell.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sandstorm.desc: A whirling storm of sand that blinds, slows, drags and grinds everyone inside.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sinkhole.desc: The ground becomes deep quicksand: enemies sink, get stuck and suffocate.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mirage.desc: Shimmering illusions confuse enemies: they attack each other or chase the images.
glyph.isekai_mahou.solar_ray.desc: A sunbeam strikes down from the sky. Stronger by day, under open sky, and against the undead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.holy_flame.desc: Golden fire that water can't put out. The undead suffer double.
glyph.isekai_mahou.solar_crown.desc: A crown of sunlight above the head burns enemies that come close.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dawn.desc: A sunrise flash: blinds nearby enemies and incinerates the undead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.greater_heal.desc: A strong heal of luminous water plus some regeneration.
glyph.isekai_mahou.holy_water.desc: A holy splash: the undead burn, other enemies get soaked and nearby allies are healed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.cleanse.desc: Removes every negative effect, fire and frost (Invert: strips the enemy's blessings).
glyph.isekai_mahou.protective_bubble.des: A bubble of holy water absorbs a lot of damage until it pops, and holds against knockback.
message.isekai_mahou.photosynthesis_shad: Photosynthesis only regenerates in sunlight (daytime, no rain, open sky).
